profile.aboutBio: I'm a 4th Year BSIT student at Pamantasan Ng Lungsod Ng Valenzuela with a deep passion for game design and development. I believe in the power of games to educate, entertain, and create meaningful experiences that connect people.
profile.careerGoals: Aspiring to become an Indie Game Designer, creating meaningful, entertaining, and immersive games to contribute not just in the Technology Industry but also in the Game Industry. I also aim to expand my knowledge in Technical Support to provide comprehensive solutions and assistance in IT environments.

works.title: ValYOU
works.description: A web application designed to automate an ARTA-compliant Customer Satisfaction Survey system. Managed the full documentation process including process flows, compliance records, and design assets using Google Docs, Excel, and Canva.
works.substoryLore: Faced with complex Anti-Red Tape Authority (ARTA) compliance requirements for citizen feedback, led the structured documentation architecture—translating regulatory mandates into clear process flows, data schemas, and accessible UI assets.

works.title: Shadow of the Past
works.description: A slasher horror game built around an atmospheric, real-camera video experience. Developed the complete spatial map layout and game environmental layers to create an immersive, tension-filled cinematic atmosphere.
works.substoryLore: Designed the complete spatial map architecture and environmental layering for Bakunawa Studios' slasher horror title. Balanced sightlines, choke points, and found-footage camera framing to sustain dread from start to finish.
works.weakness: Predictable Jump Scares (Solved via Spatial Tension)

works.title: Piso Politiko
works.description: A hybrid tabletop game that explores Philippine politics through strategic gameplay, social deduction, and resource control.
works.substoryLore: Created a satirical yet deeply strategic hybrid tabletop experience mirroring local political dynamics. Iterated extensively on economy balancing, player negotiation loops, and rulebook clarity for GameCon showcase.
works.weakness: Runaway Leader Problem (Solved via Dynamic Catch-up Mechanics)

works.title: Buwaya Catch
works.description: A fast-paced video game spin-off of Piso Politiko featuring the iconic crocodile character in an arcade progression loop.
works.substoryLore: Expanded the Piso Politiko universe into digital arcade territory using Unity. Tuned spawn curves, arcade scoring feedback, and hazard escalation to make every 60-second session immediately replayable.
works.weakness: Short Session Fatigue (Solved via Escalating Arcade Combos)

works.title: Ready-Set-Bag!
works.description: An educational mobile game teaching disaster preparedness and emergency go-bag readiness to Grade 6 students.
works.substoryLore: Spearheading both project management and game design for our BSIT Capstone project. Translating disaster risk reduction curricula for Grade 6 learners into engaging mobile gameplay mechanics with measurable educational retention.
works.weakness: Dry Educational Content (Solved via Gamified Time-Trial Packing)
